title: Transport of supported tensor relations to a restricted module
statement: Let k and D be commutative rings, let D be a k-algebra, and let M and P be D-modules with additive commutative group structures. Fix a k-subalgebra A⊆D and an A-submodule N⊆M, using restricted D-actions throughout. Write G=FreeAbelianGroup(M×P) and [u,z] for its pair generator. Let T(A,N) consist of all [0,z] with z∈P; [u,0] with u∈N; [u+v,z]−[u,z]−[v,z] with u,v∈N and z∈P; [u,z+w]−[u,z]−[u,w] with u∈N and z,w∈P; and [d•u,z]−[u,d•z] with d∈A, u∈N and z∈P. For every m∈N and p∈P, if [m,p] belongs to the additive subgroup of G generated by T(A,N), then m⊗_A p=0 in N⊗_A P.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [CommRing k] {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [Algebra k D] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module D M] {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module D P] (A : Subalgebra k D) (N : Submodule A M) (m : N) (p : P), let b : M → P → FreeAbelianGroup (M × P) := fun u z => FreeAbelianGroup.of (u, z); b (m : M) p ∈ AddSubgroup.closure {r : FreeAbelianGroup (M × P) | (∃ z : P, r = b 0 z) ∨ (∃ u : M, u ∈ N ∧ r = b u 0) ∨ (∃ (u v : M) (z : P), u ∈ N ∧ v ∈ N ∧ r = b (u + v) z - b u z - b v z) ∨ (∃ (u : M) (z w : P), u ∈ N ∧ r = b u (z + w) - b u z - b u w) ∨ (∃ (d : D) (u : M) (z : P), d ∈ A ∧ u ∈ N ∧ r = b (d • u) z - b u (d • z))} → (TensorProduct.tmul A m p : TensorProduct A N P) = 0
